regions.label: WarmBootSignature
regions.evidence: Reset compares first six bytes at $808F and copies twelve bytes to $0360 on mismatch, with X bounds $06/$0C; exact initialized signature span, not code.

Indexed graphics/animation consumers near $C000–$C57F; raw bytes are repeated tile sequences, coordinate deltas, $FF separators and zero runs. Reviewed through exact level-record boundary $C6C0; generic non-code, individual schemas unresolved.

regions.label: StageRecords
regions.evidence: Initializer $956E subtracts one from validated stage index 1..$24, constructs $C6C0+256*(stage-1), copies bounded record through Y=$FF, and uses final byte as count. 36 aligned 256-byte records; repeated block grids and zero tails, no conflicting control-flow entries.

regions.label: StageAttributes
regions.evidence: Same stage initializer constructs $EAC0+64*(stage-1), copies X=$40 bytes into stage buffer. Stage index domain 1..36 and source ends at audio jump entry $F3C0. Repeated packed two-bit nametable attributes with zero margins.

Uniform 80-byte $FF suffix ends exactly before six validated interrupt vector bytes. Boundary inspected against prior sound bytes; no conflicting code evidence. Generic data, fill purpose not claimed.

regions.label: ClearAttributePage
regions.evidence: Static contract A supplies PPU address high byte, writes low $C0, clears exactly 64 bytes through $2007 and resets scroll before RTS. Self-contained PPU routine independently supported by coherent hardware writes, bounded loop and exact return. Actual caller unresolved; legal decoding alone was not used. remaining-code.txt.

regions.label: AdditionalPPUCommands
regions.evidence: Inspected whole span after exact RTS at $A49B: repeated PPU address/count/tile command streams and $FF delimiters, matching $A3C3 interpreter. No control-flow entry conflict; no individual stream extents claimed.

regions.label: EraseLifeIcon
regions.evidence: Static entry precondition $0E is a life-icon count; decrement, bound <6, index six PPU address words at $B889, erase two tiles with $2D and resume established $B823 exit. Independent bounded table/hardware-output/control contract. Caller/natural entry unresolved. remaining-code.txt.

regions.label: SoundCommandHandlers
regions.evidence: Interpreter masks command low nibble, indexes 16-word dispatch table via pointer at $F7D1, and JMP ($E6). All 16 targets inspected; sound-discovery.json proves connected handler graph covers exact interval. Handler preconditions X=voice, Y=stream position, $E4/$E5=stream. Commands edit channel/envelope fields and rejoin established interpreter. Structural only; reachability of individual commands unresolved.

regions.label: SoundDispatchBase
regions.evidence: Two-byte pointer $F7D3 read by established $F510 dispatcher; source base for exact low-nibble dispatch indexing.

regions.label: SoundDispatchTargets
regions.evidence: 16 little-endian words addressed by 2*(command&15); all target contracts inspected and sound-handler control flow verified. Exact finite selector extent independent of selected runtime values.

regions.label: SoundTablesAndStreams
regions.evidence: Bounded inspection of entire interval: descending little-endian pitch periods; repeated duration/value envelope records; pointer banks and repeated $F0..$FF sound commands with note/duration bytes. Established audio routines reference $F7F3/$F7FB/$F8A3/$F8AB/$F8EB/$F90F and interpret streams through $E4. No conflicting code entries. Exact subdivision beyond dispatch table remains unresolved; generic non-code, not a claimed exhaustive sound schema.
